title: seseli austriacum
intro: Seseli austriacum, commonly known as Austrian pennyroyal or Austrian wild parsley, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Seseli austriacum include its ability to act as a carminative, reducing flatulence and bloating, and as an antiseptic, preventing the growth of pathogens. The bioactive constituents of Seseli austriacum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
